data.one_liner: HTTP cache manager for the Dio package using SQLite
data.what_it_does: Provides caching capabilities for Dio HTTP requests, storing responses in memory and a local SQLite database. Allows configuring cache duration, stale times, custom keys, and manual cache deletion.
use_when: You are using the Dio HTTP client and need to cache API responses locally.
You need offline fallback support using stale cache data when network requests fail.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio networking library.
You need a general-purpose key-value storage solution rather than HTTP caching.
strengths: Easy integration as a Dio interceptor.
Supports custom maxAge and maxStale durations.
Provides automated or manual cache cleaning and deletion methods.
weaknesses: Maintenance version of an older package (dio-http-cache).
Tied specifically to the Dio ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Add the interceptor to your Dio instance with a CacheConfig.
